pages.text: L_Ender's Cataclysm bosses live in dungeons that are fights in themselves. Each dungeon drops an Eye that points to the next. They are Tier 3 and 4.$(br2)Bring two people and a plan. These are not soloed in iron.
Ancient Remnant in the Cursed Pyramid (deserts). A desert king with charges and sandstorms. The pyramid's traps are half the fight. Shares $(bold)Netherite$() with the Monstrosity.
Maledictus in the Frosted Prison (snow). A knight with a halberd and lightning phases. Fought in a ring; do not leave it. Holds $(bold)Cannons$().
The Harbinger in the Ancient Factory (underground). A machine of lasers and missiles. Fight it in the open floor; the walls shoot back.
Ignis in the Burning Arena (Nether dunes and ash). A flame knight with a shield to break. Fire resistance is mandatory. Holds $(bold)Arcane industry$() (as does the Harbinger).
Netherite Monstrosity in the Soul Blacksmith (withered forest). Lava, slams, a magma bombardment. Holds $(bold)Netherite$() and heavy calibres.
The Leviathan in the Sunken City (deep ocean). Invincible outside water; fight it in its element with water breathing. Shares the $(bold)precision parts$() with the Director.
Scylla in the Acropolis (warm ocean). Storm and sea. Shares $(bold)Ender logistics$() with the Ender Guardian: the road for those who never reach the End.
Ender Guardian in the Ruined Citadel (the End). The last fight. Holds $(bold)Ender logistics$(): the lost capital's last secret.
